_readme: The Society's regular weekly schedule during teaching weeks. TO ADD AN ENTRY: copy one of the objects in 'weekly', change the fields, and save - the homepage strip, events page, printable schedule and the subscribable calendar all regenerate from this file at build time. 'day' is Monday..Sunday. Times are 24-hour local Canberra time. 'category' is one of: mass, confession, adoration, prayer, study, social, formation. Set 'liturgy': true for anything sacramental so it is included in the Mass-and-liturgy-only calendar feed.
_verification: IMPORTANT: confirm every time below with the chaplain before each semester, then update 'lastVerified'. The site prints this date so visitors know how fresh the information is.
semesterNote: Schedule shown is for ANU teaching weeks in Semester 2, 2026. Times can move in teaching breaks and exam periods - check our Instagram for the current week.
